correctness.rationale: For simplicial d-polytopes, the sharp stacked-polytope Lower Bound Theorem gives f0≤Λ(d,k,M) for each 0≤k≤d−1, including endpoints. HSW Thm3.7 applies at k=0 to actual v=f0(P), and x↦min{1,a x^(−2/(d−1))} is nonincreasing, so replacing v by Λ gives the inscribed q≠0 and q=0 inequalities. For simple circumscribed Q, polar Q° is simplicial and f_k(Q)=f_{d−1−k}(Q°); hence f_{d−1}(Q)≤Λ(d,d−1−k,M), allowing HSW Thm3.8 facet estimates. All q, d=2 endpoints, vacuous low M are handled. Finite d≤40 algebra tests are supplementary to the classical LBT.
residual_risks: The stated inequality is not a geometrically sharp all-k estimate; combinatorial stacked sharpness cannot establish optimal ball approximation.
